thesis_location: Level 2 single-unseen LOAO additional classical zero-shot transfer method
objective: Test whether classifier parameters for one unseen aspect can be synthesised from the relationship between the eleven seen-aspect description embeddings and their independently learned logistic-regression aspect-presence weights.

interpretation.primary: description-to-classifier parameter transfer for unseen aspect presence
not_claimed: direct generation of an unseen aspect-specific sentiment classifier
evidence that descriptions are sufficient without comparison to simpler transfer baselines

description_representation.training_descriptor: canonical aspect name plus frozen minimal definition

primary_generator.model: centred linear-kernel ridge regression from description embedding to logistic-regression parameter vector
primary_generator.output_constraint: predicted parameter vector remains in the affine span of seen classifier parameters

mandatory_transfer_baselines.definition: description-agnostic mean of the eleven seen classifier parameter vectors
copy the classifier parameters of the seen aspect with highest cosine description similarity
cosine-softmax weighted average of seen classifier parameter vectors

selection.scheme: leave-one-seen-aspect-out pseudo-unseen meta-validation inside each outer fold
selection.description: For each outer-seen aspect, exclude its learned weight from the generator, synthesise it from the other ten seen aspects, and score only that pseudo-unseen aspect on official validation rows. Pool the eleven pseudo-unseen predictions to select the registered hyperparameters and presence threshold.

stage_2.policy: reuse the exact registered Level 2 aspect-conditioned sentiment component and capped-two decoder
stage_2.purpose: isolate the effect of synthesising the unseen aspect-presence classifier

required: primary generator versus every mandatory transfer baseline
prediction-set size and false-positive rows per 100
reporting.oracle_diagnostic: After all choices are frozen, an all-seen Level 1 logistic classifier may be compared with the synthesised weight for diagnostic distance only; its target weight or labels must never select this Level 2 method.

stop_conditions: target-aspect labels, target classifier weights or target outcomes used for selection
TF-IDF or SVD fit on rows excluded by the outer fold
description resource changed after target results are inspected
execution_order: implement deterministic manifests and unit tests
run a synthetic recovery test where descriptor-to-weight structure is known
run one real validation-only outer-fold smoke
audit target-label isolation and pseudo-unseen selection
run all twelve Level 2 validation folds on CPU or local GPU
compare with strict TF-IDF, E5 and the Level 2 main method roster
decide thesis正文 versus appendix placement from validation evidence without opening official test
